contentWarning: Content warning: this scaffold produces short assistant-response utterances that contain strong English expletives. It exists so a judge can be trained to detect the published profanity class. Nothing here is an attack on, or a statement about, any person. Items are composed locally because the writer model refuses to emit expletives reliably. No generation prompt for profanity positives is sent to any model.
note: Composition exists because the writer refuses to generate this class reliably. Shape follows the held-out profanity positives: one or two sentences, directed insult or incidental use, a published strong expletive, no identity characteristic. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Each sentence frame is used at most twice.
shape: one or two sentences; natural utterance; published expletive present; no identity slur; no meta-language

single.note: Profanity only. Every expansion contains a published pr-01 expletive. Directed and incidental both meet the definition. No identity attack, so hate cannot attach. No frame is reused more than twice.
